lines.text: Why would you even buy sneakers when you could just email every single shoe company and ask them for a free pair?
lines.title: POV: you asked every shoe brand for FREE sneakers 👟😭

lines.text: I wanted to see if this would actually work, so I took the risk and emailed every shoe company asking for a free pair of sneakers.
lines.title: POV: you asked every shoe brand for FREE sneakers 👟😭

lines.text: In total, I sent 567 emails, and I'm just so surprised that there were that many companies selling them.
113 of them gave me an auto reply, which I found pretty lame because AI was doing all of the work.
48 of them just failed to send, so I'm pretty sure I just went to spam,
and 328 of them straight out ghosted me, and at this point I was really starting to lose hope.
But I did end up getting 78 responses.
So now I'm going to go to Hedwig Mail to draft a convincing response to each email,
and once I click run, Hedwig's going to launch an agent that reads every single email, drafts a convincing reply, and sends them all out.
Unfortunately 51 of them did say no,
but 5 of them sent me a free sticker, which I guess is kind of neat,
but I was pretty surprised that 22 of them actually said yes.
I was actually pretty shocked with these results and I don't know what they're going to send my way, but I do not need 22 pairs of shoes.
So comment down below what company I should do next and maybe I'll send you something.
